situation (example wording): "What agency is ORI NJ0225500?", "new orleans ori", "nypd's ori", "firearm murders for ORI TXHPD00 since 2018"
what the app does today: Treated as an unknown word or asked.
proposed behavior: An ORI (agency ID) is answered both ways: "What agency is ORI X?" names the agency and its place, and "NYPD's ORI" or "<city> ori" gives the ID. An ORI written as the place in any question is that agency, said in a note ("ORI TXHPD00 is the Houston Police Department."). An unknown ID is declined, naming it ("No agency has the ID ZZ00000."). Questions that need a population group ("pop_group starting with 1") stay declined: the app does not define population groups.
exact default or choices offered: The agency name or ID in one sentence; an agency named from its ID answers the question with a note.
why: Jeff 2026-11-22 (card through the coordinator): "answer both ways, accept an ID as the place in any question with a note, decline an unknown ID naming it; pop_group stays declined".
status: Decided 2026-11-22 (Jeff, through the coordinator); build: Capability (lookup) and Engine (an ID as the place)
